description: This Java class defines ProductStoreSurveyWrapper, which extends SurveyWrapper and provides functionality for handling product store survey responses, including rendering survey and result templates, managing survey application data, and handling call results.

classes.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
classes.description: A wrapper class for product store surveys that extends SurveyWrapper, managing survey templates, rendering, and responses.

methods.name: ProductStoreSurveyWrapper
methods.description: Constructor initializing the survey wrapper with survey application data, party ID, and pass-through parameters.

methods.name: callResult
methods.description: Sets the callResult flag which influences rendering behavior.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey or result template depending on the state and response conditions; throws exception if templates are not defined.
